title: Naked City
overview: Naked City was inspired by the 1948 motion picture The Naked City. Filmed on location in New York City, the series centered on the detectives of NYPD's 65th Precinct.

episodes.title: Meridian
episodes.overview: Wearing a new hat given to him by his wife Dt.Halloran begins his first day as a newly promoted Detective. After being assigned to partner "legend" Dt.Dan Muldoon he's soon face to face with a cop killer and his accomplice who's taken hostages at the New York Coliseum.

videoFile.name: Naked City TV 1958 colorized s01e01 "Meridian".mp4

episodes.title: Nickel Ride
episodes.overview: Lt.Muldoon reluctantly takes on the task to tell the veteran Captain of the Staten Island ferry, it might be time to retire. At the same time armed robbers are completing a heist of an armored car on the same ferry.
